Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Bobby Portis?

Bobby Portis is 31 years old.

Where was Bobby Portis born?

Bobby Portis was born in Little Rock, Arkansas.

When was Bobby Portis born?

Bobby Portis was born on February 10, 1995.

How tall is Bobby Portis?

Bobby Portis is 6-9 (206 cm) tall.

How much does Bobby Portis weigh?

Bobby Portis weighs 250 lbs (113 kg).

Is Bobby Portis in the Hall of Fame?

Bobby Portis is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Bobby Portis drafted?

Bobby Portis was drafted by Chicago Bulls, 1st round (22nd pick, 22nd overall), 2015 NBA Draft.

What position does Bobby Portis play?

Power Forward and Center.

What is Bobby Portis' net worth?

Bobby Portis has made at least $78,404,314 playing professional basketball.

How much does Bobby Portis make?

Bobby Portis made $15,000,000 in 2020.

How many rings does Bobby Portis have?

Bobby Portis has won one championship.

What is Bobby Portis' Instagram account?

Bobby Portis is on Instagram at bportistime.

What schools did Bobby Portis attend?

Bobby Portis attended Hall in Little Rock, Arkansas and Arkansas.

What are Bobby Portis' nicknames?

Bobby Buckets, The Mayor of Milwaukee, BP, Crazy Eyes, Big Bob are nicknames for Bobby Portis.
